parts.title: Pet Buddy Quest: Play Along With Pip, Momo and Basil! | TheOneApp Promo
parts.description:
Watching is fun. Playing is better! Pet Buddy Quest is a play-along game for all 28 Primary 3 episodes of TheOneApp, Explained, and every line is voiced. Lock in your answer, then see what Pip, Momo and Basil picked. Hear a mistake? Shout "Hold on!" Spot Basil's mistake in the Showdown, get hands-on in a mission, and beat GLITCH, the robot who learns from your mistakes. Win stars and badges on the way. Now in TheOneApp, the science study app for Primary 3 to 6 in Singapore.

Parents: see TheOneApp and try it free for 7 days at https://theoneapp.sg

The only app you need to learn Science: TheOneApp.
